name: Generated Image
description: A picture drawn by an AI image model from your prompt, which an AI text model can rewrite first. Choose the text and the image source separately: the text of one provider can go with the picture of another. The keys are in each provider's settings.

properties.name: randomizePrompt
properties.title: Rewrite the Prompt
properties.description: Have a text model rewrite the prompt before each picture, so no two are alike.

properties.name: keepInGallery
properties.title: Keep in the Gallery
properties.description: Keep each picture in the Gallery (a data source of its own: enable it) so it can be shown again without paying for it again.
